description: Java entity class representing a product option in an e-commerce system, including fields for sorting, type, descriptions, merchant store association, and code.

classes.name: ProductOption
classes.description: Entity class for product options with properties like type, code, descriptions, and associations to merchant store.

methods.name: getProductOptionSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order of the product option.

methods.name: setProductOptionSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order of the product option.

methods.name: getProductOptionType
methods.description: Returns the type of the product option.

methods.name: setProductOptionType
methods.description: Sets the type of the product option.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of descriptions for the product option.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the descriptions for the product option.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the product option.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the product option.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with the product option.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with the product option.

methods.name: setDescriptionsList
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions for the product option.

methods.name: getDescriptionsList
methods.description: Returns the list of descriptions for the product option.

methods.name: getDescriptionsSettoList
methods.description: Returns the descriptions as a list, converting from set if necessary.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code for the product option.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code of the product option.

methods.name: setReadOnly
methods.description: Sets whether the product option is read-only.

methods.name: isReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if the product option is read-only.
